indication_area: Immunology/inflammation (rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, plaque psoriasis)
geography: U.S. and Canada (Immunex: U.S. from the November 1998 launch, U.S. and Canada from Canada's March 2001 launch; Amgen: ENBREL U.S. plus ENBREL International/Canada); American Home Products/Wyeth/Pfizer held the rights elsewhere
moa: TNF-alpha blocker (soluble TNF receptor fusion protein)
series_start_reason: Series starts 1998Q4, the launch quarter: Immunex's 1998 Form 10-K states 'Sales of ENBREL commenced on November 4, 1998, and totaled $12.7 million for 1998'. Immunex (CIK 719529) booked Enbrel through 2002Q1 (its last Form 10-Q); Amgen's second-quarter 2002 release prints Immunex's 2002Q2 Enbrel sales before the July 15, 2002 close; Amgen's own series runs from 2002Q4. 2002Q3 is not citable as a full quarter (see unreported_quarters).
search_log: listed Amgen (CIK 0000318154) filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages), keeping every form starting '8-K' (8-K and 8-K/A) or '10-' (10-Q, 10-K, amendments): 323 8-K, 2 8-K/A, 98 10-Q, 31 10-K; the two 8-K/As are dated 1995 and 2020 and are not earnings releases

took every 8-K carrying Item 2.02 from 2012-01-26 to 2026-08-04, fetched each filing's index.json, and kept the exhibit that contains both 'Enbrel' and 'Repatha' or 'Prolia': 59 earnings-release exhibits covering the fourth quarter of 2011 through the second quarter of 2026, no quarter missing

parsed each release's HTML table rows; the product table ('$Millions, except percentages' with U.S., ROW and TOTAL columns) was checked for every quarter, and for each fiscal year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year table in the fourth-quarter release (all matched exactly for the rows used)

pre-2012: Amgen's earnings releases (2004-2012-01) print only 'Enbrel - U.S.' and 'Enbrel - International/Canada' lines with no total; Amgen's Forms 10-Q and 10-K print a 'Total ENBREL' row (scanned every 10-Q/10-K from 2002-06 to 2013-06 for rows 'Total ENBREL'/'ENBREL'): totals printed from the June 2004 10-Q (with prior-year column), so 2003Q2, 2003Q3, 2004Q1 are prior-year columns and 2003Q1 is six months less second quarter

fourth quarters 2003-2010 are derived (annual_less_reported_first_nine_months) from the Form 10-K total and the September Form 10-Q nine-month total; the fourth-quarter earnings release prints no total. 2011Q4 is the prior-year column of the Q4 2012 release (also equals 3,701 - 2,756). Each derived row's two inputs sit in different documents, so the verifier's one-line check cannot pass them

2012Q1 from the March 2012 Form 10-Q (the Q1 2012 release prints only U.S. and Canada lines); 2012Q2 onward from each quarter's own release ('Enbrel' row with U.S., ROW (Canada) and TOTAL); full-year sums for 2012-2025 matched the full-year tables
Amgen's 10-K for 2024 states 'We market ENBREL ... in the United States and Canada' and prints 'ENBREL - U.S.', 'ENBREL - Canada', 'Total ENBREL'

[g4_us extension 2026-11] Joined the Immunex series (rows of companions/immunex_enbrel_quarterly.csv, 1998Q4-2002Q1, each re-verified against its Immunex 10-Q/10-K by verify_staged_manifests.py) to the Amgen series. Listed Immunex (CIK 719529) filings via data.sec.gov submissions: last periodic report the 10-Q for 2002Q1 (filed 2002-05-09), 15-12G 2002-07-16.

Listed Amgen (CIK 318154) 8-K, 10-Q and 10-K filings 2002-07 to 2003-11 and read the ENBREL rows and text: the 2002-07-26 release (Exhibit 99.1) prints Immunex's 2002Q2 ENBREL sales in text (192, and 217 for 2002Q1, matching Immunex's 216.5); the Q3 2002 10-Q prints only the July 16-September 30 part-quarter (158.1, text); the 2002 10-K prints ENBREL 362.1 for July 16-December 31, so 2002Q4 = 204.0. Amgen filed no item 2.02/12 earnings 8-K for 2002Q3 or 2002Q4. The 2003-04-29 release's trend columns print ENBREL U.S. 150.5/195.7 and International 7.6/8.3 for 2002Q3/2002Q4; their sums (158.1, 204.0) agree with the derived totals, but regional lines are not summed into the series.
1998Q4 row: the companion's quote '| 12.7' is kept, with derivation changed to direct_reported (the full year is all fourth-quarter sales) so that the single printed figure is the row's own value.

unreported_quarters.2002Q3: Ownership change Immunex to Amgen; no full-quarter figure is published. Amgen closed the Immunex acquisition on July 15, 2002 and began recording ENBREL sales on July 16, 2002; its Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2002 prints only the part-quarter 'For the period from July 16, 2002 through September 30, 2002, ENBREL sales were $158.1 million', and Immunex filed no report after its Form 10-Q for the first quarter of 2002 (15-12G filed 2002-07-16), so July 1-15, 2002 is unpublished.

launch_evidence.quote: On November 2, 1998, the FDA approved ENBREL for treatment of advanced rheumatoid arthritis. Sales of ENBREL commenced on November 4, 1998, and totaled $12.7 million for 1998.
